text: {"lessons":["My account rose and fell while I made no trades, so these short-term moves don’t show that I can predict what prices will do next.","Selling Stock D after a large gain shows that I can take profits, but I should base future sell decisions on its prospects from today rather than the size of my gain or cost basis.","I rarely trade, and that can be sensible; I should still review my holdings periodically and make deliberate choices rather than letting reluctance to admit a mistake dictate what I keep."]}
